limitations: contract_clause_kind: 19 REJECT and 12 UNRESOLVED adjudicated dispositions are not persisted; world stores ACCEPT tuples only per no-closed-world epistemic contract.
invoice_contract_association and commercial_dependency_status: all 12 admitted dispositions are PURPOSE-scoped and were not written to 06_world/world.sqlite.
acquisition_relevant_clause: PURPOSE-derived relation declared in vocabulary but not instantiated in world sqlite; purpose projection remains downstream.
invoice_contract_association disposition vocabulary uses asserted/unresolved in P1; P5 packets record ACCEPT for the one asserted linkage — mapping is purpose-local, not promoted here.

admissions.reason: Authoritative billing fields compiled from invoices.json; truth does not depend on which diligence purpose is active.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: If purposes A/B/C disappeared, each invoice tuple would still state the same id, billed name, amount, currency, period, and status grounded to its source row.

admissions.reason: Contract file identity, counterparty text, and compiled active/expired status are source-grounded facts independent of analytical thresholds.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: If purposes disappeared, contract_id, party text, and active boolean would retain the same meaning and truth conditions from the contract markdown sources.

admissions.reason: CRM account id, displayed name, and status-to-active mapping are direct compilations from crm.csv.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: If purposes disappeared, each CRM row would still denote the same account with the same compiled active flag.

admissions.reason: Registry company number, legal name, and status are authoritative registry facts compiled mechanically.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: If purposes disappeared, registry tuples would still report the same legal entity rows without reference to any diligence question.

admissions.reason: Whether contract source text substantiates a named clause kind is a document-grounded proposition independent of acquisition-relevance or dependency policies.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: If purposes disappeared, an ACCEPT tuple still means the cited contract language satisfies that clause kind; REJECT/UNRESOLVED are withheld from world per epistemic contract.

admissions.reason: Same-entity, distinct, and unresolved judgments are evidence-bounded identity facts about source identifiers, not answers to a particular purpose output schema.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: If purposes disappeared, each SAME_ENTITY/DISTINCT/UNRESOLVED tuple would still assert the same identity relationship with the same grounding; prefixed identifier strings are rendering conventions, not purpose-dependent truth.

admissions.reason: Deterministic orthographic legal-form variants are mechanically derivable from registry and related source text without purpose thresholds.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: If purposes disappeared, variant pairs would still denote the same registered-form abbreviation relationship.

admissions.reason: Linkage is framed for purpose A exposure reporting and purpose C joins; asserted means confident association for this diligence question, not a general invoice-governance fact.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: If purposes disappeared, whether an invoice is confidently associated with a contract for exposure reporting would lose its analytical meaning; the proposition depends on the requested association judgment.

admissions.reason: Projects world ACCEPT clause kinds through purpose A allowed_kinds policy; acquisition-relevant is an analytical label, not independent contract text truth.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: If purpose A disappeared, filtering clause kinds by acquisition policy would be undefined; the relation encodes purpose policy, not standalone world semantics.

admissions.reason: Commercial dependence applies a two-part purpose C test combining open invoices, active contracts, obligation kinds, and identity linkage under purpose thresholds.
admissions.purpose_independence_test: If purpose C disappeared, dependent/unresolved status would lose meaning because the two-part dependence test and inclusion policy are purpose-defined.
